summary.text: Rhonda Shader is the Republican candidate for California State Senate District 34 in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing Democrat Avelino Valencia in a race with no incumbent.
She was first elected to the Placentia City Council in 2016 and has served two terms as mayor, according to her Ballotpedia survey responses.

paragraphs.text: Rhonda Shader was born in Whittier, California, and earned a high school diploma from Buena Park High School and a bachelor's degree from the University of Phoenix in 1997.
Her career experience includes working in insurance and financial services.
In a 2026 Ballotpedia survey, Shader said she launched Placentia's first independent fire department and helped create a city-county infrastructure district.
She also listed service on the St. Jude Medical Center Community Health Committee, the Orange County Human Relations Commission, and the board of the nonprofit Lot 318.
Shader ran for the same State Senate seat in 2022 and lost the general election to incumbent Democrat Tom Umberg.
In the same survey, Shader named cutting the gas tax, defending Proposition 13 taxpayer protections, public safety and reducing regulation on small businesses as her campaign's key messages.
